title: Harden autonomous delivery controls
outcome: Tickets have durable integration history, controller-scoped execution authority, fresh role identities, and revision-bound quality gates.

protectedWriteAuthorization.rationale: The accepted criteria change the exact agent and skill controls guarded by those files.

scope: Durable integration anchors and dependency-at-base validation
Version-2 execution authority and controller-issued role identities
Revision-bound Deno task definitions and independent guards
Matching agent, skill, template, and delivery documentation
nonGoals: Changing application or canonical schema behavior

acceptanceCriteria.text: Integrated tickets remain historically valid after later unrelated commits and dependencies are proven integrated at the dependent ticket base.
acceptanceCriteria.redProof: integration_anchor_regression_test.ts fails on missing integration anchors, integration checks, integration.md binding, and dependency-at-base validation.

acceptanceCriteria.text: Ordinary tickets cannot write protected control paths and protected maintenance is limited to exact controller-authorized files; .git is always forbidden.
acceptanceCriteria.redProof: control_guards_regression_test.ts fails because execution classes and protected-path authorization are not validated.

acceptanceCriteria.text: Every new implementer and reviewer run is controller-issued, namespaced to the ticket, role- and round-bound, and fresh at its issuance site.
acceptanceCriteria.redProof: control_guards_regression_test.ts fails because v2 run provenance and cross-round freshness are not enforced.

acceptanceCriteria.text: Required task definitions are read from exact base and candidate revisions, and changed tasks require an unchanged independent guard.
acceptanceCriteria.redProof: real-Git task fixtures fail because the validator trusts mutable task names and self-reported exits.

acceptanceCriteria.text: Agent prompts, the ticket-loop skill, templates, and delivery documentation match the enforced v2 protocol.
acceptanceCriteria.redProof: Static asset tests added after core GREEN must fail before each corresponding documentation or template change.

baseline.name: test:schema:matrix
baseline.definition: deno task test:schema && deno task test:schema:compat

candidate.name: test:schema:matrix
candidate.definition: deno task test:schema && deno task test:schema:compat

risks: A permissive legacy exception could bypass the new authority model
A mutable task definition could self-certify a no-op quality gate
An unbounded Git inspection could exhaust resources
An integration anchor could conceal merge-time changes to reviewed files
